notes.title: The Location Name Update!
notes.content:
We’ve been hard at work on Airhead since it launched a while ago and today we can proudly release a new patch that will enhance the world of Airhead even more!

The main focus of this update is the new location name feature. You can now see the name of each location displayed on the screen as you enter it and save at an air cylinder there. This will make it easier to understand where you are in the game and – should you need to look up a solution for a puzzle – makes it easier to find the right spot in walkthroughs or guides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35100421/05d6719c6507b8df8d8ad042322e70d01b22d006.png[/img]

Additionally, we’ve worked to improve the balancing of some puzzles a bit and have decreased the amount of air Head loses while filled with heavy air by 20%, which makes the timing on some tricky sections more forgiving!

We’ve also improved some visuals and fixed a lot of bugs. See the full changelog below for everything the update contains!

[b]Full changelog:[/b][list]
[*]Location names are now displayed when saving in a new area for the first time
[*]Head now loses air 20% slower while being filled with heavy air
[*]Heavily improved visuals during a certain secret ending
[*]Updated several shadows in the game to look better
[*]Improved look of water and glass surfaces on low-quality settings
[*]Fixed a memory leak that would slowly drain the performance or crash the game during longer play sessions on weaker hardware
[*]Fixed a case where the game would sometimes get stuck in an infinite loading screen shortly after interacting with a rope
[*]Fixed a soft lock where players were able to bypass an obstacle without having an Airhunter help them.
[*]Fixed a possible soft lock that occurred when players bypassed the first room in the mines with a well-timed double jump.
[*]Fixed a possible soft lock where a cleaner would block an elevator on the roof of the left tower.
[*]Fixed a soft lock related to quickly jumping off of a moving rope in the mine
[*]Fixed an issue where tutorials would sometimes not fully disappear from the screen
[*]Fixed an issue in a puzzle with two robots in it
[*]Fixed an issue where a segment of the map in the small mountain area would sometimes not get uncovered
[*]Fixed a certain glowbee easily stopping to follow the player on its intended path
[*]Reduced volume of pushing a certain train piece to fit the rest of the game volume
[*]Fixed a glowbee appearing in the wrong spot and then just disappearing after a few seconds
[/list]

We hope you continue to have a great time with Airhead!

notes.title: Airhead is now Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

our Steam Deck Compatibility rating is in and we are happy to announce that Airhead is [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]! 

That means that you can explore the mysterious and intriguing world of Airhead wherever you like, and you don’t have to worry if the text is too small, or that you have to manually change the settings for it to run well, or that it shows you the wrong controls. 

[h3]Steam Deck Verified Bundle[/h3]
In case you are looking for more games that are Steam Deck Verified, we have a great bundle for you with all HandyGames titles that have been optimized for the Steam Deck, why don’t you go and check it out!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28120/HandyGames_Verified_Steam_Deck_Bundle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35100421/f6199948645c869a325b2264013bdd430c566e4e.jpg[/img]
[/url]

notes.title: The story behind Airhead
notes.content:
[h2]Dark caves, suspicious creatures, and deep colors.[/h2]

[b]What is the story of Airhead and where does the Body come from?[/b]
Find it out today in our [b]developer live stream at 11:30 AM CET[/b] and join us in the booths at the Indie Arena Booth! Don't miss to watch our live events on our Twitch channel [url=https://twitch.tv/handygames_official]twitch.tv/handygames_official[/url]

[b]We will dive into the technical making of the Game with our Streamer Tobias from the developers, moderated by Jan from Handy Games.[/b]

[b]Experience a beautiful art style[/b] while being filled with a sense of responsibility and urgency to help your friend. With a heavy focus on puzzle solving, this unusual challenge will require you to use your Head and Body both separately and together.

Join our community and chat with the developers on our Discord channel!
https://discord.gg/tKY8jrh
